title: Adobe security advisory (AV26-1146)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1146 Date: November 12, 2026 As of November 10, 2026, Adobe is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Cloud Service (CS) Prior to or equal to 2026.10.29251 Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) 6.5 Multiple versions Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) 6.5 LTS Prior to or equal to Service Pack 1 - Cumulative Hotfix for GRANITE-75052 Prior to or equal to Service Pack 2 - Cumulative Hotfix for GRANITE-75052 Prior to or equal to Service Pack 3 - Cumulative Hotfix for GRANITE-75052 Adobe Premiere Prior to or equal to 27.0 and 26.5.3 Adobe Photoshop 2027 Prior to or equal to 28.0 Prior to or equal to 27.11.1 Adobe Media Encoder Prior to or equal to 26.5.2 Prior to or equal to 25.6.6 Adobe Dimension Prior to or equal to 4.1.10 Adobe Audition Prior to or equal to 27.0 Prior to or equal to 26.5.3 Content Credentials Rust SDK Prior to or equal to c2pa-v0.91.11 C2PA Tool Prior to or equal to c2patool-v0.28.6 Adobe After Effects Prior to or equal to 27.0 Prior to or equal to 26.5.3 Adobe Connect Multiple versions The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web link and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Adobe
